verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a catalog of 600–700+ maintained connectors spanning APIs, databases, warehouses, and lakes, plus a no-code Connector Builder with AI Assist to add custom ones when needed, and community testimonials confirm real-world use pulling data from 'weird places' across many sources. Minor community complaints (setup friction, hard-delete edge cases) are secondary caveats rather than contradictions of the catalog breadth claim. Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of connector maintenance quality/freshness across the full catalog.
